properties.inspection_comments: Purpose: To conduct a food safety inspection in accordance with WAC Chapter 246-215. Notes: - First routine inspection after change of ownership inspection. - Due to 35 or more red points, a follow-up inspection will be conducted for the red item violations noted in this inspection report. A fee of $240 will be assessed by mail for all follow-up inspections. If repeated red item violations are observed at a follow-up inspection, an additional follow-up inspection will be required. - Do not stack TCS food items on top of containers in top of prep cooler . - Ensure all raw meats are stored in order of cooking temperature and store below ready to eat foods. - Obtain a digital tip sensitive thermometer. - As of March 1, 2023, all food establishments must have a Certified Food Protection Manager. They need a certificate in food safety management from an accredited program. They take and active approach to train staff and prevent foodborne illness . - Date mark or label cold food kept for more than 24 hours. The day you prepare, or open food is day one. You must serve or discard the food by the 7th day. For example, if you open or prepare food on Friday, serve or discard it by the next Thursday . - Facility has completed the following compliance orders: 1) Facility left 2 door prep cooler on the cookline is broken and not on. 2 door prep cooler is getting replaced with a new 2 door prep cooler. 2) Mop sink drainline has fallen off and water drains on the floor . Repair mop sink drain line to drain into the floor drain next to the mop sink. 3) Front hand sink hot water handle is stuck. Unable to determine if hand sink has access to hot water and is blocked. Relocate table in front of hand sink and fix hot water handle. Hot water must reach 100F. - Facility has the remaining compliance orders left to complete to avoid the $240 fee for non-compliance: 1) 2 compartment food prep sink is missing an drainboard. If operator installs a custom drainboard that hinges up and down on the left side, the drainboard must be at least equal to area of one compartment with smooth transition without any gaps and with rounded edges. All surfaces must be easily cleanable, durable, and nonabsorbent. Meat and produce are prepped at different times , sinks are properly washed and sanitized between uses. 2) Facility uses the white homestyle Simply Perfect microwave for customer orders. Replace with a commercial microwave that is NSF approved or equivalent. Compliance Schedule OBSERVATIONS AND CORRECTIVE ACTIONS You must complete the following items by the due date listed below . Your inspector will do a compliance inspection . If these items are not corrected, you will be billed for the inspection. Violations cited must be corrected within the time frames specified . Complete ByItem Number 11/06/2026 2600 Compliance with valid permit; operating and risk control plans and required written procedures. 2600 Observed slicer in the prep room. Slicer is not on approved floor plan or equipment list that was provided during the change of ownership inspection. Per PIC, facility slices meat with the slicer. You need plan review approval before you change your menu , equipment, or procedures. You can find a plan review application at www.tpchd.org/healthy-places/food-safety/opening-a-food-business. Call 253-649-1706 if you need assistance. Stop using slicer immediately and remove from facility. PIC may apply for plan review if wanting to add slicer to the equipment list and floor plan. *Compliance order issued to stop using the slicer and remove from the facility immediately. Failure to stop using the slicer and remove it from the facility immediately will result in a fee of $240 for non-compliance. Contact your inspector with questions or if you need more time to complete these items.
